Datensatzklasse Record4<A1,A2,A3,A4>

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.quurz.foomp.base.util.Record4<A1,A2,A3,A4>
Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first value
A2 - the type of the second value
A3 - the type of the third value
A4 - the type of the fourth value
Alle implementierten Schnittstellen:
Supplier<A1>, Appliable4<Record4.µ, A1, A2, A3, A4>, Copyable<Record4<A1,A2,A3,A4>>, Mappable4<Record4.µ, A1, A2, A3, A4>, Transmogrifyable<Record4<A1,A2,A3,A4>>, Value<A1>, Value2<A1,A2>, Value3<A1,A2,A3>, Value4<A1,A2,A3,A4>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher4<Record4.µ, A1, A2, A3, A4>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Hkt<Record4.µ>
public record Record4<A1,A2,A3,A4>(A1 value1, A2 value2, A3 value3, A4 value4) extends Record implements Appliable4<Record4.µ, A1, A2, A3, A4>, Mappable4<Record4.µ, A1, A2, A3, A4>, Transmogrifyable<Record4<A1,A2,A3,A4>>, Copyable<Record4<A1,A2,A3,A4>>, Value4<A1,A2,A3,A4>, org.quurz.foomp.higher.Higher4<Record4.µ, A1, A2, A3, A4>

A record-based, immutable 4-tuple carrying four non-null values. This type provides value accessors, structural updates (with1/with2/with3/with4), mapping utilities (map1/map2/map3/map4/mapAll), applicative application (applyTo), conversions (toTuple), transmogrification and copying.

Semantics:

  • Non-null contract: inputs must not be null, results must not be null.
  • Eager evaluation: mapping and applicative application evaluate immediately.
  • Structural equality: equals/hashCode compare values component-wise.
  • Stable string format: Record4[value1=..., value2=..., value3=..., value4=...]

Seit:
1.0.0
